title: Sarj module architecture CALM decorator
description: Organization-specific profile of CALM 1.3 decorators. Source annotations are captions followed by @architecture, min_view and replacement, separated by single spaces.

summary.description: Short role-oriented caption, reusing the module's existing purpose. No technology inventory or sensitive literals.

min_view.description: Cumulative visibility: overview appears in all views; standard in standard and detailed; detailed only in detailed. Hidden elements aggregate into their nearest visible parent, retaining source elements and relationship provenance in the complete export. These are presentation levels, not C4 abstractions.

replacement.description: Reviewed architectural boundary. contract: preserve externally consumed interfaces without persistent data/state conversion. migration: preserve those interfaces but require persistent data/state conversion. redesign: require consumer/interface changes, whether or not migration is also needed. unknown: unassessed. Interface means consumed API, protocol and data contract, not a fixed endpoint literal. Classify redesign before migration before contract; never infer safety, hot swapping, zero downtime or a Terraform no-op. Render explicit badges; migration/redesign retain that qualification when visually abstracted; unknown never implies replaceable.
